updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
BETA 3.1.7.5
- Additional updates since last Beta notes:
  - FLT PLN runtime NAVLOG stabilized to prevent disruptive resets during live server updates; mission runtime snapshot handling hardened for in-mission reliability.
  - Runtime waypoint numbering alignment completed: runtime NAVLOG starts at waypoint 0 and SA map waypoint labels now match NAVLOG runtime numbering.
  - TOT speed recommendation interaction improved: tapping a flashing recommended speed now applies it directly; subsequent taps open the standard speed edit popup.
  - EFB SA Map right-rail behavior refined: chart rotation controls are now chart-mode only and replaced by AD quick zoom in SA Map mode.
  - AD quick zoom behavior updated: second press restores the pre-AD zoom level while preserving follow/ownship camera behavior.
  - Added Quick Settings option: EFB Display AD on Landing. When enabled, EFB auto-switches to SA Map and enables AD zoom on landing roll when GS < 80 kts and WOW = ON (landing assist only; no takeoff auto-revert).
  - Added SA Map doghouse controls and rendering updates: doghouse overlays can be toggled in SA Layers and follow map zoom/routing presentation for leg readability.
  - Expanded SA Map user waypoint workflow details: persistent user waypoints support add/select/center/rename/delete flows with dedicated visibility control and stable popup behavior.
  - Fast ownship GPS integration expanded with GS support and retained as a pilot troubleshooting toggle (fast vs legacy server ownship source).
  - Added hidden long-press GPS diagnostics panel (2s hold) for fast ownship telemetry checks without persistent UI clutter.
  - Removed/disabled WOW speed-triggered forced refresh behavior that caused FLT PLN/EFB instability; WOW now relies on normal processed server state cadence for stability.
  - FLT PLN/EFB help manual expanded to document new controls and behaviors (runtime numbering, AD quick zoom, landing assist setting, doghouses, user waypoints, GPS diagnostics, and related workflow updates).
  - Auto ATA / REC SPD workflow expanded and stabilized: 0.5 NM transit capture in both sim and live modes, with segment-crossing support and sequence gating for close/co-located waypoints.
  - Auto ATA visuals refined: waypoint symbols pulse/highlight on successful transit capture; REC SPD top-rail balloon behavior improved for reliability and no-placeholder display.
  - REC SPD unable-state guidance added in EFB balloon: shows limit speeds with status text (220 + UNABLE DELAY, 700 + UNABLE ACCEL) when recommendations are out of bounds.
  - EFB help icon legend updated and polished: compact icon sizing aligned to in-app control scale, missing airport chart drawer icon restored, and legend placement clarified under EFB controls help.

- Summary since last Beta:
  - ATC FLOW / Suppress Auto rework: manual-gated ATC and carrier progression now blocks auto sequencing until matching pilot calls are made, while preserving expected follow-up responses.
  - Added managed ATC.lua orig+append install path tied to Suppress Auto, including clean restore behavior on unload.
  - Refined runway and carrier voice/progression gating for Request Landing, Check Landing Gear, Taxi to Parking, Tower Overhead, and Ball flows.
  - AH-64D George AI updates from Sleighzy integrated (command/control and contextual mapping reliability improvements).

- OpenKneeboard Out / Navigraph EFB:
  - Added full Navigraph device-flow auth path with improved status handling.
  - Added encrypted storage for Navigraph auth/credentials handling and removed legacy EFB credential/token entry UI.
  - Added default tiles scope in OAuth flow and refresh handling updates.
  - Added Navigraph chart catalog/image loading with day/night chart support and improved airport search/list labels (ICAO + name).
  - Added explicit module-connection state in OpenKneeboard snapshots and stricter no-module gating for EFB/Navigraph activity.
  - Added stale session-data purge on module disconnect and mission end so EFB no longer keeps old charts/SA content after disconnect.

- OpenKneeboard Out SA Map Tiles and Layers:
  - Added Navigraph enroute background tiles through local proxy with day/night switching.
  - Added SA map Navigraph layer selector (VFR / IFR LOW / IFR HI) with persistence and immediate mode switching.
  - Added tile request stability/performance improvements (cookie-jar auth flow, request-mode learning, cache key separation for 1x/2x, reduced request fan-out, bounded bridge request concurrency).
  - Added immediate background redraw on layer or night/day change without leaving SA map (Navigraph and OpenFreeMap).

- OpenKneeboard Out SA Map Overlay/Markup:
  - Increased waypoint and airport symbol scale for improved readability on detailed map backgrounds.
  - Increased waypoint/airport label size and offsets to match scaled symbols.
  - Restored and enlarged bugged-target red selection ring for larger symbols.
  - Changed route line color to magenta and increased route/DTC line thickness (including overlay markup such as additional routes).
  - Preserved ownship follow/track-up map behavior during airport bugging and background chart preloading, including stable return state when switching back to SA map.

- OpenKneeboard Out SA Map User Waypoints:
  - Added gesture-only long-press waypoint creation directly on SA map with persistent user waypoint storage.
  - Added dedicated user waypoint drawer workflow (select, center, rename, delete) with VR-friendly radial rename input.
  - Added dedicated user waypoint render layer with hollow-triangle symbols, labels, and selection highlighting.
  - Added user waypoint visibility toggle in the SA layers drawer with a matching triangle icon.
  - Fixed user waypoint bug popup persistence so it remains open until clicked again.

- OpenKneeboard Out Mouse Controls:
  - Added voice command support to switch focus between DCS and OpenKneeboard Out, enabling reliable mouse control on OKB Out when needed.

- OpenKneeboard Out Charts and Loading UX:
  - Improved local chart fallback when Navigraph has no airport data (404/empty) by strengthening local folder/root resolution and airport token matching.
  - Added retry-throttled handling for transient empty chart responses to reduce stale no-chart states.
  - Reworked EFB loading messages to non-disruptive overlay to avoid replacing active chart/map content during background airport/chart loading.

- OpenKneeboard Out UI/Logging:
  - Reduced Navigraph logging noise: normal flow is concise status; chart/tile fetch logging is error-focused.
  - Suppressed expected transient worker-disconnect log spam from OpenKneeboard request workers.
  - Normalized EFB no-module empty-message font behavior to match other tabs.

- Existing OpenKneeboard Out and JTAC enhancements from prior Beta remain included (EFB chart controls, SA map migration from FLT PLN, ownship/follow/track-up improvements, JTAC overlays/history/persistence, and simulation-mode updates).

- AIRIO RIO: reclassified and renamed LANTIRN Stabilize command to LANTIRN category/key consistency (wMsgLANTIRN_STAB_GROUND).
